summary: Regression - unable to update IBS approval code
reported_issue: Users could not update the IBS approval code - the field was greyed out (showed a red 'no' circle on hover) and had no save option.
expected_after_fix: The IBS approval code field should be open to edit and a save button should be present/enabled when edited.
steps_i_followed: Identified customers with an IBS code set (e.g. Aavale Apparel, ibs=783666)
Opened the customer (/customers/{id}) and clicked Edit to open the customer edit form (the IBS approval code field lives here)
Inspected the IBS field state and attempted to change the value
Changed IBS from 783666 to 783699 and clicked Save
Verified persistence via API, then restored the original value 783666
actual_now: The IBS field is fully editable (input readOnly=false, disabled=false), not greyed out. Editing enables the Save button. Saving fired POST /api/customers/change (HTTP 200) and the value persisted (API confirmed ibs=783699). Original value restored to 783666 afterward.
notes: IBS approval code is a per-customer field edited via the customer Edit form; it now accepts edits and saves end-to-end. Test change was reverted.
